summary: iter-117 backlog: SilentBotBanner, PartnerBrokerCard, AgentReportCard — end-to-end verified. 15/15 new backend HTTP tests pass in test_iter117_backlog_features.py covering (a) GET /api/bot/pulse now returning `notable`+`notable_stale_seconds` per config with routine 'cooldown active' SKIPs excluded from notable, (b) GET /api/agents/report-card shape (baseline+agents+totals+method), verdict enum validation, 1h cache honored on 2nd call without force, force=true rebuilds with new built_at, (c) GET /api/partners/brokers lazy-seeds 3 defaults (Exness/IC Markets/Vantage) with is_placeholder=true + is_admin flag + sort ordering, (d) admin POST upsert flips is_placeholder→false when link no longer contains 'PLACEHOLDER', persists via GET, (e) admin DELETE + 404 on re-delete, (f) non-admin gets 403 on POST and DELETE (fresh registered+verified user), (g) POST /brokers/{id}/click increments clicks by 1 and returns {url}=broker.ib_link. Frontend E2E as admin: Dashboard renders `silent-bot-banner` with 'AI HOLD 35.0% — MEDIUM and LONG tiers both DOWN...' from VTMarkets 16s ago; expander reveals 5 bot rows each with own notable reason (data-testid='silent-bot-row-{cfg_id}'). Agents page shows agent-report-card with baseline strip (Win rate 76.6% of 406, Avg $51.54/$-151.2, EV +$4.10, Total impact -$430.50), 1 active row (Execution Guards 105 hard blocks, -$430.50, CONSIDER ADVISE), 16 quiet hidden, method line present; REBUILD button works with no errors. Accounts page shows partner-broker-card at bottom with 3 tiles (Exness starred+highlight, IC Markets, Vantage) each with regulation, MIN DEPOSIT, and OPEN ACCOUNT button (data-testid='partner-broker-open-{id}'). No console pageerrors on /, /agents, /accounts, /bot-config, /trades. Regression: MarketPosture, BotPulsePanel, ArchitecturePipeline, and account list all still render normally.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_routes.py:65 _ser() correctly excludes _id and stringifies via 'id' — good MongoDB pattern.

partner_routes.py:101 is_placeholder derived from string search 'PLACEHOLDER' in ib_link — brittle if admin picks a link that legitimately contains that substring; consider explicit is_placeholder field or regex on '{PLACEHOLDER}' pattern.

partner_routes.py DELETE endpoint does not soft-delete (irreversible) and there is no restore path for defaults. Test seed only fires when count_documents({})==0, so an accidental delete-all leaves the collection empty until manual re-seed. Consider a per-name upsert seed or /partners/brokers/reset endpoint.

agent_report_card.py caches under {user_id: ...} without account/version key — if AGENTS list is extended, the cache stays stale for up to 1h until force=true is called. Not user-facing but worth a cache-key bump on schema change.

bot_runner.py _record_pulse:152 'is_routine' uses substring match 'cooldown active' on reason — will also skip other cooldown-active variants like 'Loss cooldown active' which arguably ARE notable blockers. Consider matching only the specific SKIP-with-signal-cooldown case (e.g. reason == 'Signal cooldown active').

SilentBotBanner.jsx 30s poll interval is fine, but component silently swallows API errors ({/* silent */}) — a broken /bot/pulse would just make the banner disappear with no user signal. Non-critical.

PartnerBrokerCard.jsx open() catches errors but only shows a toast — if the click POST fails, the OPEN ACCOUNT button falls through and does nothing (no window.open). Could fall back to b.ib_link unconditionally to still open the link.

AgentReportCard.jsx shows raw slug in data-testid but the request spec listed 'report-row-risk-managed-trading-4' — the actual slugs are 'mtf', 'consensus', 'execution', etc. so that specific test-id would only exist if an agent slug happened to be 'risk-managed-trading-4'. Assumed request was giving a slug example based on preview hostname; verified 16 real rows render with the actual slugs (test-id 'report-row-execution' visible for Execution Guards row).
